ROA v0.2 - ThirdParty Libraries Installation Complete
======================================================

Date: December 29, 2025
ROS2 Version: Humble (December 2024 release)
Source: https://github.com/ros2/ros2/releases/download/release-humble-20241205/

Installation Summary
--------------------

✅ rclcpp (ROS2 C++ Client Library)
   Location: ThirdParty/rclcpp/
   - Headers: 114 directories
   - Libraries: 43 .lib files  
   - Binaries: 29 .dll files
   
   Key components:
   - rclcpp (core C++ API)
   - rcl (ROS Client Library)
   - rcutils (utilities)
   - rmw_fastrtps_cpp (Fast-DDS middleware)
   - rosidl (type support)
   
   Message types included:
   - sensor_msgs (JointState, Image, IMU, etc.)
   - trajectory_msgs (JointTrajectory)
   - geometry_msgs (Twist, Pose, Transform)
   - nav_msgs (Odometry, Path)
   - std_msgs (basic types)

✅ Fast-DDS (Fast Data Distribution Service)
   Location: ThirdParty/FastDDS/
   - Headers: 103 directories
   - Libraries: 100 .lib files (includes all message type support)
   - Binaries: 2 .dll files (fastcdr-1.0.dll, fastrtps-2.6.dll)
   
   Components:
   - fastcdr (serialization)
   - fastrtps (DDS implementation)
   - All ROS2 message type support libraries

Directory Structure
-------------------

ThirdParty/
├── rclcpp/
│   ├── include/          (ROS2 headers)
│   ├── lib/              (.lib files for linking)
│   └── bin/              (.dll files for runtime)
├── FastDDS/
│   ├── include/          (Fast-DDS headers)
│   ├── lib/              (.lib files for linking)
│   └── bin/              (.dll files for runtime)
└── INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md  (Usage instructions)

Next Steps
----------

1. ✅ Libraries installed
2. ⏭️  Rebuild UE5 plugin (ROA.Build.cs will auto-detect)
3. ⏭️  Check console for "ROA: Native ROS2 mode enabled"
4. ⏭️  Test DDS communication with WSL

Build System Auto-Detection
---------------------------

When you rebuild the plugin, ROA.Build.cs will:
1. Detect ThirdParty/rclcpp/include exists
2. Add include paths to compiler
3. Link .lib files from ThirdParty/*/lib
4. Copy .dll files to Binaries for runtime
5. Define ROA_NATIVE_ROS2=1 preprocessor macro

Expected Console Output:
------------------------
ROA: Checking for ThirdParty ROS2 libraries...
ROA: Found rclcpp at: ThirdParty/rclcpp
ROA: Found FastDDS at: ThirdParty/FastDDS  
ROA: Native ROS2 mode enabled
ROA: Added runtime dependencies (31 DLLs)

Troubleshooting
---------------

If build fails:
1. Verify file permissions (should be readable)
2. Check Visual Studio 2022 is installed
3. Regenerate project files (right-click .uproject)
4. Clean and rebuild

If runtime errors:
1. Verify DLLs copied to Binaries folder
2. Check Windows PATH for conflicting ROS2 installations
3. Use Dependency Walker to check DLL dependencies

Performance Expectations
-----------------------

After rebuild:
- UE5 plugin will use native ROS2 DDS
- Latency: <5ms (vs 50-100ms with TCP)
- Joint state publishing: 30 Hz
- Direct UDP multicast communication
- No TCP server needed
